item_short_desc: Delve into the depths of military expertise with Rothco’s Combative Hand to Hand Combat FM21-150 Manual. This military field manual consists of over 150 pages with action-driven illustrations that offer insights into a wide array of topics. With chapters covering fundamentals of hand-to-hand, most vulnerable points of the body, knife attacks and their counters, silencing sentries, fall positions and throws, countering attacks, strangles, and take-downs, the manual provides a comprehensive guide for military hand-to-hand combative maneuvers.
description: Delve into the depths of military expertise with Rothco’s Combative Hand to Hand Combat FM21-150 Manual. This military field manual consists of over 150 pages with action-driven illustrations that offer insights into a wide array of topics. With chapters covering fundamentals of hand-to-hand, most vulnerable points of the body, knife attacks and their counters, silencing sentries, fall positions and throws, countering attacks, strangles, and take-downs, the manual provides a comprehensive guide for military hand-to-hand combative maneuvers. Illustrated Pages: This field manual features over 150 pages filled with detailed illustrations to ensure easy comprehension and practical application of hand-to-hand combat maneuvers. Timeless Wisdom: The combat manual contains lessons and techniques that transcends decades, offering invaluable insights for both the battlefield and emergency situations. Portable Size: The military instruction manual features compact 8 inch x 5.5 inch dimensions, ensuring it fits easily into your tactical gear or backpack for convenient on-the-go reference.
